notes: Adds VERSION, CHANGELOG.md, and release manifests.
Adds a stable release index for version-aware updater work.
Adds installed app version display in the Application Update area.
Changes online update checks to target the stable release tag named by upstream releases/latest.json.
Changes online update apply behavior to fast-forward merge the selected release tag instead of pulling arbitrary branch head.
Adds release-aware offline bundle creation with tools/create_update_bundle.py --release <version>.
Adds release details to offline bundle manifests and offline update checks.
Shows release summary, notes, rollback version, and installed release details in update messages.
Keeps existing branch/commit offline Git bundle manifests compatible.
summary: Adds release metadata, installed version display, and release-aware online and offline app updates.
